name: Product Manager
responsibilities: Own a product area end to end: lead user research to find the real pain points, draft the requirements, oversee the build, and coordinate the launch through to field adoption
Build and prioritize the roadmap, translating complex customer, business, and regulatory problems into clear deliverables engineering can execute
Align engineering, design, and go to market partners around one direction, and communicate that direction, its trade-offs, and progress to leadership
skills: Writing PRDs, specs, and wireframes that make the why and the what unambiguous to engineering and design
Defining and tracking the KPIs and adoption metrics that show whether a launch actually worked, then iterating on the roadmap from what they say
Technical fluency in APIs and data modeling: enough to push back on a tech lead on the merits of a direction, not to write the code yourself
Communicating with influence across technical and executive audiences, and staying effective when the problem is ambiguous

evidence.title: University 2026 Intern: Product Manager
evidence.quote: Build and prioritize roadmaps, translating complex requirements into clear deliverables that improve scalability, compliance, and user experience. ... Technical fluency in APIs, data modeling, and scalable architectures. ... Strong communicator able to influence across technical and executive audiences.

evidence.title: Product Manager, AI Access
evidence.quote: Deliver product specifications, prototypes, product positioning, and high-impact launches. Partner with Engineering, Design, Research, and GTM to ship at high velocity. ... A strong communicator who is comfortable with ambiguity. Technically literate ... you should be able to push back on a tech lead on the merits of a particular direction.

evidence.title: Product Manager - Revenue Tools
evidence.quote: Discovery: Lead deep user research to identify, document, and anticipate core seller pain points ... Design: Draft comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and design artifacts (wireframes) ... Launch: Coordinate all aspects of release, including change management, enablement programs, and documentation for seamless field adoption. Adopt & Iterate: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs and adoption metrics) to measure business impact and inform rapid roadmap iterations.
